## Purpose

This chapter details the agreed analyses we apply to registry data to create our BNR public statistics. It governs definitions and calculations; the workflow pages explain how the BNR analysts run those calculations.

## Documents

- **[Statistical Analysis Plan](sap.qmd):** population, event definitions, measures, comparisons, uncertainty, quality checks and disclosure principles.
- **[Metric specification register](sap-metrics.qmd):** implementation-ready definitions for each routine indicator.

## When an analysis or definition changes

Use this section before creating a new measure, changing an existing one or changing the way a result is described.

| Situation | What to do |
|---|---|
| You want to carry out an analysis | Check that it is covered by the Statistical Analysis Plan before starting work. |
| You need the definition of an established indicator | Use the metric register. It gives the approved definition, population, time period and calculation. |
| You think an existing definition or method needs to change | Discuss and record the proposed change before changing production code or publishing new results. |
| A change affects what the public result means | Update the Statistical Analysis Plan, metric register, analytical code and Public Methods Manual together. |
| A change has been agreed | Keep the decision and the related files in normal Git history and release records. |
